notes.definition: Default transport; physical state, FW and role select the production paths.
notes.launch_rule: Cell-subset launches reset synchronization counters before each chunk. Device launch budgets and SOSFUSE2_LAUNCH_CELLS determine chunking.
notes.sh_combine: SH_COMBINE requires an enabled stratosphere. The SH order is jobs/run_state.py SH_L.
notes.gate_v2: Fixtures FX-C3 and FX-S2 cover exact and approximate transport. G-P uses rtol 1e-3; G-T uses checks/gate_data/anchors.json.
